rubric_intent: Score this product description on engineering substance for an AI observability platform.

dimensions.name: AI Workload Specificity
dimensions.description: Measures how clearly the description articulates the specific engineering challenges and benefits related to AI workloads.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Look for explicit mentions of AI model performance, AI cost optimization, AI reliability, or other AI-specific engineering concerns addressed by the platform.

dimensions.name: Technical Foundation Clues
dimensions.description: Assesses whether the description provides any hints about the underlying engineering architecture or technology stack.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Search for terms like 'cloud-native stack', 'microservices', 'distributed systems', or specific technologies that suggest the engineering approach.

dimensions.name: Observability Depth
dimensions.description: Evaluates the extent to which the description suggests the platform offers deep, actionable insights into AI workloads, beyond superficial metrics.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine phrases related to 'instant visibility', 'model performance', 'cost', and 'reliability' to infer the depth of observability provided.

dimensions.name: Engineering Benefit Articulation
dimensions.description: Determines how well the description translates technical features into tangible engineering benefits for users.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Analyze the 'Why teams choose Hyperflow' section and other benefit-oriented statements for clear connections to engineering outcomes like speed, reliability, and confidence.

dimensions.name: Credibility Indicators
dimensions.description: Assesses if the description includes any elements that build engineering credibility or trust.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Look for mentions of 'trusted by leading AI-first companies' or any other social proof that implies engineering validation.

dimensions.name: Actionability of 'Get Started'
dimensions.description: Measures whether the call to action implies a straightforward engineering integration or evaluation process.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Evaluate the 'Get started today' phrase in the context of the overall description to infer if it suggests a quick and easy engineering setup.
